name: Koga Tatsuki
source: A classmate of the protagonist. A member of the track and field club. She respects Akira, who was her senior in the club. She is always checking to make sure the protagonist doesn't hurt Akira. The protagonist and he have been best friends since elementary school, and they were quite close, but at some point, she started to look down on the protagonist. She is quite stubborn.
